A:base/src/lgtestp4.cbl::NO-UPD.why: NO-ADD (the paragraph before NO-UPD) is one EVALUATE CA-RETURN-CODE whose branches WHEN 70 and WHEN OTHER both end in Go To ERROR-OUT, so it never falls through; nothing PERFORMs or GO TOs NO-UPD. The key's reader treated any EVALUATE as possibly falling through; _evaluate_is_terminal now recognises an exhaustive (WHEN OTHER) EVALUATE whose every branch transfers, and the key marks NO-UPD dead. Re-running the reader over all four keys changes only this unit.

trunc:base/src/lgtestp1.cbl@102-113::L10.why: ssmap.bms defines ENP1CMK with LENGTH=20, so its generated symbolic-map input field ENP1CMKI is PIC X(20) (#3490: the symbolic map is derived from the BMS source when its copybook is not shipped); lgcmarea.cpy line 66 declares CA-M-MAKE PIC X(15). 20 > 15 truncates.
